name: Internal Meeting Minutes Summarizer
description: An internal tool that takes Arabic or English meeting notes typed by employees and produces a short summary and an action-item list. The employee reviews and edits the draft before sharing it. It does not make or influence any decision about a person.
documentation:
INPUT: meeting notes only. Employees are instructed not to paste personal data, and an input filter redacts phone numbers, emails and ID numbers before the text reaches the model.
HOSTING: the model runs in a cloud region inside Saudi Arabia under a signed data processing agreement; no data leaves the Kingdom.
HUMAN OVERSIGHT: summaries are never sent automatically; the employee must review, edit and click Share.
ACCESS AND LOGGING: company SSO only; every request is logged with user and timestamp; logs retained 1 year.
RETENTION: notes are discarded immediately after the summary is produced; summaries follow normal document retention.
TRANSPARENCY: every output is labelled 'AI-generated draft - review before sharing'.
QUALITY: the PMO reviews 50 random summaries every quarter for accuracy and omissions; prompt-injection tests passed before launch.
